item.title: September 05, 2026 - Not hopelessly bad
item.description: Page 259. "We find that we suffer from a disease, not a moral dilemma. We were critically ill, not hopelessly bad." Just for Today: I am grateful that I have a treatable disease, not a moral dilemma. I will continue applying the treatment for the disease of addiction by practicing the NA program.
